name: Kai Goldenapple
source:
Kai doesn’t do attachments. He does missions. He does bloodstains. He does clean-up. At the ISWA, they call him The Cleaner—the guy you send in when things go wrong and you need them to quietly disappear. Monsters. Evidence. People. He handles it all without blinking.

He’s sharp, sarcastic, and always three steps ahead. He kills abnormals without question. Without care. Whether they were once innocent or not is irrelevant. To him, they’re already gone.

There’s something dangerous behind his smile. He knows more about the ISWA and its leader than he lets on. But whether that knowledge will save Oliver…or break him… remains to be seen.
